architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

consumed_events.name: SarCaseClosed
consumed_events.purpose: Trigger secure download link generation and delivery to customer via digital channel

design_decisions: SVC-017 provides the SAR submission portal (online banking) and secure response delivery link. It does not own the SAR case — that is SVC-015's domain.
SVC-015 owns SarCase (ENT-072) and orchestrates the data extraction workflow.
SVC-015 publishes EVT-159 SarCaseOpened which triggers SVC-001 and SVC-014 to respond with data extracts via async events.
SVC-014 (KYC/AML) is intra-capability with SVC-015 (both in CAP-005) — KYC data extraction is a direct service call within CAP-005.
SVC-001 (CAP-001) data extraction is cross-capability — triggered by EVT-159 and SVC-001 responds with a data extract event.

consumed_events.name: SarCaseOpened
consumed_events.purpose: Intra-capability: extract KYC/AML records for the customer and return to SVC-015 for SAR compilation

design_decisions: SVC-014 and SVC-015 are both within CAP-005 — intra-capability communication. SVC-014 responds to SarCaseOpened by providing its data extract directly to SVC-015.

consumed_events.name: SarCaseOpened
consumed_events.purpose: Cross-capability: extract account data, transaction history, and communications data for the customer; publish data extract event back to SVC-015

design_decisions: SVC-001 (CAP-001) responds to EVT-159 by querying its own data stores and publishing a SAR data extract event consumed by SVC-015. This preserves data ownership while enabling compliance access — no direct database query from SVC-015 to SVC-001's store.

consumed_events.name: SarCaseOpened
consumed_events.purpose: Send SAR acknowledgement to customer with case reference and 30-day deadline

consumed_events.name: SarCaseClosed
consumed_events.purpose: Send response delivery notification to customer with secure download link

consumed_events.name: SarCaseOpened
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable SAR receipt record (ICO audit)

consumed_events.name: SarCaseClosed
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable SAR closure record including days_to_close for SLA reporting

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-017 (CAP-007) → SVC-015 (CAP-005): SAR submission via Channel→Capability API pattern
SVC-015 (CAP-005) → EVT-159 → SVC-001 (CAP-001): Cross-capability data extraction request; SVC-001 responds with data extract event
SVC-015 (CAP-005) → EVT-160 → SVC-017 (CAP-007), SVC-053 (CAP-007), SVC-103 (CAP-008): Case closure notifications all async via Event Bus
